description: Charter scope checkpoints, read by .claude/scripts/shared/lib/charter-scope.js and the commands that call it (#3001). The helper assembles the inputs; the calling command makes the alignment call, named and reported with its reason (#3645). Checks are conversational, never blocking: the user can expand scope, defer, proceed or revise. Formerly the always-on 04-charter-enforcement rule.

create-backlog.checks: the PRD each epic and story is created from

proposal.checks: the proposal title and problem statement

loads: the board: open epic and PRD tracker titles

scopeCall.description: How the calling command makes the alignment call from the assembled inputs (#3645). The verdict is a judgment about meaning, named and reported; the helper makes none.

verdicts.conflicts: The work's main deliverable is something an Out of Scope bullet names.
verdicts.aligned: The work serves an In Scope bullet (at full depth, the board themes show what the project is working on now).
verdicts.possibly-misaligned: The work does neither: it serves no In Scope bullet and its main deliverable is nothing an Out of Scope bullet names.

scopeCall.notAMatch: A shared word is not a match: judge what the work delivers, not which words it shares with a bullet.
scopeCall.reportFormat: Charter scope: <verdict> — "<bullet quoted>" — <reason in one sentence>
scopeCall.unavailableThemes: When boardThemes.available is false, say the board themes were unavailable and make the call on the charter bullets alone.

aligned.description: The work serves an In Scope bullet, or (quick depth) its main deliverable is nothing an Out of Scope bullet names
aligned.action: Report the call and proceed without interruption

possibly-misaligned.description: The work serves no In Scope bullet, and its main deliverable is nothing an Out of Scope bullet names
possibly-misaligned.action: Report the call and ask the user to confirm

conflicts.description: The work's main deliverable is something an Out of Scope bullet names
conflicts.action: Report the call, flag the conflict and offer the resolution options

resolutionOptions.label: Expand charter scope
resolutionOptions.action: Follow expansionFlow, then continue with the original work

resolutionOptions.label: Defer to a future release
resolutionOptions.action: Note in the work item: "Deferred - out of current scope"

resolutionOptions.label: Proceed anyway
resolutionOptions.action: Log a scope-drift warning and continue

resolutionOptions.label: Revise the work item
resolutionOptions.action: Help the user change the work item to fit current scope

expansionFlow: Ask which scope item to add
Add it to the CHARTER.md In Scope section as a short founding capability
Record the expansion in a Construction/Design-Decisions/YYYY-MM-DD-charter-scope-<item>.md entry that names the work item it was added for

optOut.perSession: The user says to skip charter validation for this session; the command then does not call the helper
optOut.quietMode: The user asks for quiet validation: ask only on conflicts; possibly-misaligned is reported but not asked (helper flag --quiet)
